title: Welcome to Wondercase
subtitle: Vietnam, Cambodia & Thailand
panel: Home · Maps · Essentials · Gallery · The Group · More
steps: Open the app using your TD’s link. Travelers do not need a TD login to explore the app.
Follow the itinerary from Hanoi through Vietnam and Cambodia to Thailand. Your departure’s dates appear in the app.
The tutorial shows the app’s own tabs with sample guest information, then explains each one. Your own dates, contacts and updates appear in the app.

title: Install on your phone
subtitle: Keep your travel companion close
steps: Open the app link in Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android.
Choose Add to Home Screen (or Install app), then confirm. Browser wording can vary.
Use More → Help & Tutorials for the detailed iPhone and Android videos.

title: Home · Daily schedule
subtitle: Home is your starting point
panel: Choose a date or use the day arrows
Read the schedule and the TD’s announcement
Check again before leaving the hotel
steps: Home shows each day’s date, city and schedule. Choose a day with the arrows or calendar.
Follow Hanoi, Hue, Da Nang, Hoi An and Saigon, then Siem Reap, Chiang Mai and Bangkok.
Read the TD’s announcement and check again before leaving the hotel. Times and activities may change.

title: Maps · Explore the journey
subtitle: The big map stays above the city tiles
panel: Tap a city name or marker
Or choose a city tile below
the TD’s Google Maps open separately
steps: Tap Hanoi, Da Nang, Saigon, Siem Reap, Chiang Mai or Bangkok on the large map to open the TD’s map.
Angkor Wat opens the TD’s Siem Reap map. Hue uses its available uploaded map or a Google search.
City tiles below the map offer the same maps and any additional maps the TD shares.

title: Essentials · Travel information
subtitle: Hotels, flights, guides and handouts
panel: Your latest schedule stays on Home
steps: Open Essentials for hotel details, internal flights, local guides and available handouts.
Vedana Lagoon Resort is a lunch stop on this itinerary, not an overnight hotel. Check the Hotels section for your actual overnight stays.
Review shared documents online. Download a needed PDF before setting out; current flight and schedule updates take priority.

title: Gallery · Shared memories
subtitle: Your gallery membership is separate
panel: Already joined: continue into your photos
steps: Tap Gallery. It opens the group’s photo gallery directly.
If you have not joined on this browser, follow the gallery’s Join instructions.
Returning members enter according to the gallery’s saved membership. Safe sign-in does not sign you into the gallery.

title: The Group · Fellow travelers
subtitle: Find your card and select your meals
panel: Choose a meal → submit before its cutoff
steps: the TD reveals the guest list when it is ready. Your guest card includes Safe and Meal choices links.
Open Meal choices from your guest card and add dietary restrictions or allergies at the top.
Choose the meals the TD has made visible. Submit each meal or all open meals, and check the confirmation and deadline on each menu.

title: Your private Traveler Safe
subtitle: Sign in and you are in
panel: Automatic access · no PIN or Safe name
steps: Sign in to Traveler Safe with your preferred email and password, or Google. New email accounts confirm their email first.
Your Safe opens automatically. There is no PIN, activation step or Safe name to set. Keep using the same account.
Upload a document or save a personal activity. Use Share beside a saved item to invite another guest. The rest of your Safe stays private.

title: Safe · Share a selected item
subtitle: Use the recipient’s sign-in email
panel: Share beside a document or saved activity
Plans: view only or view and edit
steps: Choose Share beside a document or saved activity, then enter the other guest’s sign-in email.
Documents allow viewing and downloading. For plans, choose View only or View and edit this plan.
Send the invitation to their Safe. It appears inside the app; no email is sent. Only the chosen item and its updates are shared.

title: Safe · Accept and use shared items
subtitle: Sharing → Invitations → Accept
panel: View or edit according to permission
steps: Sign in with the email used for the invitation. Open Shared with me & invitations, then choose Accept.
Accepted documents and plans appear under Shared with me. Download a document or open a shared plan.
View-only plans cannot be edited. With editing permission, choose Edit shared plan and save your changes. Other activities stay private.

title: Safe · Manage or stop sharing
subtitle: You stay in control of the selected item
steps: Under Shared by me, choose Stop sharing to end future access. Removing the original item also makes it unavailable.
People authorized to use the recipient’s Safe can access accepted items. Recipients can remove shared items from that Safe.
Stopping sharing cannot erase copies already downloaded. Use Refresh shared items or Refresh plans to see current information.

title: More · Learn and get help
subtitle: History, language and feedback
steps: Open More for recommended reading, travel ideas and extra information.
Choose Learn more for historical trivia and the Language lessons tile.
Help & Tutorials has guides and installation help. Use Help Wondercase Grow to share feedback.

title: Help whenever you need it
subtitle: Stay connected and check for changes
panel: Ask the TD about travel updates
steps: Use More → Help & Tutorials for the interactive walkthrough, printable guide and phone installation videos. These explain the app controls; the current schedule is always in the app.
Internet is needed for updated schedules, Safe content and shared photos. Downloaded PDFs and videos can be opened on your device.
Use The Group for your TD’s contact details. Never include passwords or private documents in feedback.
